name: 卓茨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2177
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 209）｜贫（崖洞出身，英雄往上不看）｜照常（轻装好俯冲，身上不带火）｜5档｜传奇取这一纪顶上那一身；有翼的那几部不造炉、不烧魔晶，甲用黑曜鳞和骨，照亮用他帐里那种发青光的矿片；要俯冲，甲做轻、背后开翼口；他恨照得人没处藏的火，身上一点火也不带。
who: Zots, a winged demon of the raiding clans across the north wall, called the Tower-Feller, a legend who has looked about twenty since his name was made: about 194 cm, narrow-waisted with a long back and shoulder blades hard as stone. A pair of great blue-black feathered wings, and no horns (the wings alone mark him). On the left wing, close to the root, a bare patch of skin where the feathers were burned off in childhood and never grew back (his left, on the viewer's right when he faces us). Black hair cropped very short with a blue sheen, dark gold eyes, cool pale skin. A curved climbing hook strapped on his right wrist. When he smiles only the upper lip lifts a little. The proud, sharp air of a young noble guest who refuses to be welcomed.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, sharp, handsome young man's face of about twenty: dark gold eyes under straight black brows, a narrow nose, a thin closed mouth with the upper lip lifted very slightly; black hair cropped very short with a blue sheen; cool pale skin; no horns.
build: 194 cm, tall and narrow-waisted with a long back, hard shoulder blades and lean, corded arms, carrying the folded wings.
palette: blue-black and dark gold, cold ore blue, fire-scorched black, bone white
casual: His own clothes in the clan camp: a close-fitting sleeveless jerkin of dark grey leather cut open down the back for the wings, a long-sleeved black wool shirt, dark trousers and soft wrapped boots; the curved dark-steel climbing hook strapped on his right wrist, the leather on its back once burned black and since replaced; a few chips of a pale blue glowing ore hang on a cord at his belt in place of any lamp. He stands with the wings folded and the left one drawn a little behind him, a cool, unimpressed look.
private: Alone in his fireless tent: the jerkin off, a loose long-sleeved dark linen shirt cut for the wings, soft trousers, bare feet. He holds a small clay pot of salve in one hand, a single chip of blue glowing ore in the other, a guarded, private look.
battle: Diving on the watchtowers at night, in the finest flying war harness of the winged clans: a fitted cuirass of black obsidian scales laced over dark leather, shaped like layered feathers and left open at the back for the wings, the scale edges lit a faint cold blue by chips of glowing ore set along them; long bone-plated vambraces, the right one ending in the curved dark-steel climbing hook, its back wrapped in fire-blackened hide; a short stiff mantle of black feathers at the shoulders; tall soft boots bound with bone bands. No fire anywhere on him. The great blue-black wings are half spread and angled down for a dive, the bare patch at the left wing root showing; he leans forward with the hook raised, a cold, contemptuous look.
formal: Hailed by his clan after the night of the three towers: a long dark grey coat to the knee, open at the back for the wings, with a high collar of black feathers, a sash of dark blue cloth and plain bone clasps down the front; a single chip of blue ore hung at the throat; the climbing hook on his right wrist. He stands very straight with the wings folded high, a proud, distant look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the dark gold eyes looking down at the viewer, a thin, proud look with the upper lip lifted a little; the edge of a blue-black wing behind his shoulder. Cold blue light from a chip of glowing ore on one side, dark icy cloud on the other. Foreground blur: drifting black feathers and flecks of ice. He wears the dark grey leather jerkin.

name: 伊璐涅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2255
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 211）｜中（碧湾海魔人家）｜照常｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身；魔族不烧魔晶，海魔照用青铜、珠母和海草筋，钟谱刻成发青光的声纹；小腿上的鳞要露出来，要下水，裙甲两侧开衩、不穿重甲。
who: Ilune, a sea-demon woman of the sunken tide palace at the bottom of a green bay, called the Bell of the Drowned Palace, a legend who has looked twenty-three or twenty-four since her name was made: about 173 cm, narrow-shouldered and long-legged. Cold white skin, fine blue-black scales on the nape of the neck and down the calves. Long deep green hair that looks almost black when wet, often pushed back to bare a straight, proud forehead. Silver-grey eyes. Behind each ear a translucent fin-membrane. She draws a small breath before she speaks. A long-handled bronze mallet is always with her. A cool, proud air, slow to smile, that softens at once when her mother calls her name.
face: FACE, as in the references: a cool, elegant woman's face of about twenty-four: long narrow silver-grey eyes under fine slender brows, a straight nose, closed lips of a deep rose shade; a straight proud forehead with the deep green hair swept back; cold white skin; a translucent fin-membrane behind each ear.
build: 173 cm, narrow-shouldered and long-legged: a slim back, a D-cup, a narrow waist and full, rounded hips.
palette: deep sea green and blue-black, silver grey, old bronze, nacre white
casual: Her bay-dweller's clothes: a sleeveless long tunic of woven sea-grass fibre in deep green, belted at the waist with a cord of plaited kelp sinew, close dark leggings to the knee that leave the scaled calves bare, flat sandals; a short cape of pale nacre-grey cloth over the shoulders. She carries the long-handled bronze mallet over one shoulder, its old binding cord ending in a small childish knot. A cool, impatient look.
private: At home in her mother's old house: a loose long-sleeved dress of pale grey-green linen to the ankle, the hair loose and damp, bare feet. She holds a chipped old clay bowl wrapped in a fold of cloth in both hands, a reluctant, soft look.
battle: Striking the drowned bell, in the finest gear of the sea-demon houses: a fitted cuirass of overlapping old bronze plates shaped like bell rims, each engraved with rings of sound-script that glow pale sea-green, worn over a long dark sea-grass tunic slit at the sides for swimming; nacre-plated pauldrons trailing a short cape of deep green; bronze greaves open at the back to bare the scales of the calves; bronze vambraces ringed like a bell's lip. She swings the long-handled bronze mallet back in both hands, a sliver of broken bell-bronze glowing in its haft and rings of pale green sound rippling out from its head; the ear-fins flared, a cold, set look.
formal: Returning to the drowned palace for a gathering of the bay: a long gown of deep sea-green sea-grass silk to the floor with fitted long sleeves and a modest neckline, a mantle of nacre grey edged with small polished shells, a thin bronze circlet set with a single pale pearl, the damp hair swept back. She holds the bronze mallet upright at her side like a staff, a proud, still look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the silver-grey eyes glancing back at the viewer over one shoulder, a cool, unsmiling look, the ear-fin translucent in the light. Green-blue light filtering down through deep water from above. Foreground blur: drifting grains of sand and the chipped rim of a great bronze bell. She wears the sleeveless sea-grass tunic and the nacre cape.

name: 约尔妲·赫尔吉朵蒂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2138
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 207；1020年到天灾）｜贫（守墙兵户）｜朴素（守墙的人，不挂装饰）｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身，英雄往上不看家境；画的是549年摘镣那一夜往后，那时还没有成批的附魔铠甲，用量身打的老墙钢，只一圈白色墙文；样子朴素，招牌是腕上的断镣和白链。
who: Jorda Helgidottir, a woman of the northern wall, called the Fetter-Bearer, a legend who has looked forty-two since her name was made: tall, about 178 cm, broad-shouldered with strong arms, the left wrist a little thicker than the right. Thick grey-gold hair cut level at the jaw, deep blue eyes, two fine lines between the brows that never quite ease. A broken old iron shackle with a short length of chain, its break wrenched open by hand, wound around her waist and held still with one hand so it does not clink. A short knotted length of hemp rope tucked in her belt. Strangers think she is angry at first sight. A steady, few-worded, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a cool, strong woman's face of about forty-two: deep blue eyes with faint fine lines at the outer corners, two fine vertical lines between straight grey-gold brows, a straight nose, a firm closed mouth; thick grey-gold hair cut level at the jaw; fair skin a little reddened by the cold.
build: 178 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders and back, muscular arms with the left wrist thicker than the right, a D-cup, a firm waist and broad hips, long sturdy legs.
palette: grey gold and deep blue, wall-stone grey, old iron black, snow white
casual: Her garrison clothes on the north wall: a long undyed grey wool garrison coat to the knee, faded and patched at the cuffs, over a leather jerkin and a dark wool shirt, thick trousers and fur-lined boots; a thin cord tied around her right wrist; the broken iron shackle and its short chain wound around her waist, her left hand resting on it to keep it quiet; the knotted hemp rope tucked in her belt. A plain, watchful look.
private: At her father's stone house by the gate: a heavy long-sleeved knitted wool tunic in oatmeal grey, dark trousers, thick wool socks, the hair tucked behind the ears. She holds an old iron door hinge in one hand and a twist of rope in the other, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Hauling the winged one down out of the clouds, in the north wall's finest war harness, heavy and plain: a fitted breastplate and backplate of dark old wall-steel over quilted leather, edged with a single line of white wall-runes that glow cold; broad rounded pauldrons, steel vambraces and gauntlets; the grey garrison coat cut short as a surcoat, a heavy grey cloak lined with white fleece. The broken iron shackle is clamped on her left wrist, and from it a chain of blinding white light, bright as noon snow, loops close around her and rises over her shoulder as she braces and hauls with both hands. A hard, set look.
formal: At the hanging of a new shackle over the gate: the long grey garrison coat brushed clean, the small iron badge of her wall section nailed at the chest, a dark blue wool scarf, the thin cord at the wrist, the old broken shackle wound at the waist. She stands upright with one hand on the shackle, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the deep blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, a steady, stern look softening a little at the corners. Hard white snowlight from above, cold blue shadow on the other side. Foreground blur: a few links of glowing white chain and falling snow. She wears the long grey garrison coat.

name: 帕琪·满仓
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2216
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 205）｜中（蜜酒丘陵车队人家）｜不靠装备（靠车和铜壁护人，不拿兵器）｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身，可她是赶车的，不穿甲，把这一纪最好的手艺用在赶车外套的铜包边和铜护腕上，招牌是掌心的铜光和车轮形的铜壁。
who: Patty Fullbarn, a halfling caravan mistress of the mead hills, called the Copper Wheel-Ring, a legend whose name was fixed in her mid-forties, in the prime of a halfling's life, with a round young-looking halfling face: small, about 121 cm, with a sturdy, thick back. Orange-red curly hair tied up in two round buns, light spring-green eyes, a few freckles across the nose. Her palms are stained faintly green by copper. Her pockets are always full of dried fruit and copper nails. A loud, cheerful, practical air; she counts the wagons by the sound of their wheels and always asks who is still missing.
face_extra: Only faint laugh lines at the outer corners of the eyes show her age.
build: 121 cm, small and round, sturdy, with a thick strong back.
palette: orange red and spring green, polished copper, wheat gold, canvas white
casual: Her driver's clothes on the road: a short dark brown leather driving coat with copper buttons and many pockets, over a long-sleeved green wool shirt, a wide leather belt, knee breeches and sturdy boots; a bright braided cord with a small copper wheel charm hangs at her belt; a coil of cargo rope over one shoulder. She stands with one hand raised as if counting wagons, a bright, laughing look.
private: At the evening stop: a loose long-sleeved wool dress in mustard yellow, a knitted shawl, the buns half undone. She holds a small red cushion in both arms, a soft, waiting look.
battle: Ringing the wagons with copper, in the best road gear a caravan legend can have made: a long driving coat of thick dark leather riveted all over with copper, its edges banded in polished copper that glows warm along engraved wheel-pattern lines; copper-plated shoulder caps and wide copper bracers; heavy gloves with copper-studded palms; a belt hung with coiled rope and copper nails. She holds both green-stained palms out, and a ring of copper light shaped like a great spoked wheel turns close around her at waist height, a cargo rope wound tight in one fist; a quick, fierce look. She carries no blade.
formal: At the copper well-curb of the village she saved: a clean long-sleeved green wool dress under a short copper-buttoned jacket, a woven sash, the buns neatly pinned with copper wheel pins. She holds a small copper wheel in both hands, a proud, warm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the light green eyes crinkled in a wide smile turned to the viewer, the lips closed. Warm copper-coloured firelight from below on one side, dusk blue on the other. Foreground blur: a spoke of a wagon wheel and a glint of copper. She wears the brown leather driving coat.

name: 艾诺蒂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2333
gear: 传奇（撼世，818年凝名时在英雄前半，约960年LVL 212；2611年到天灾）｜中（翠冠配雾人家）｜法袍（只穿浅色）｜5档｜名字凝住以后不再老，照传奇顶上那一身画；她是唱歌引雾的，不打近身，穿精灵守林人一路的树皮鳞轻甲罩浅色长袍，偏好只穿浅色；818年在1020年以前，不写成批的附魔铠甲。
who: Enoti, a wood elf of the mist-mixing families of the crowned forest, called Mist Rising to the Sky, a legend who has looked twenty-four or twenty-five since her name was made: about 175 cm, long-limbed, with a firm waist from years of climbing trees. Long, very pale grass-green hair. Eyes of a pale violet. Long pointed elf ears, a small white mole on the tip of the left ear (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us). A shawl sewn with small clear glass beads that glow green one by one when mist grows thick. A slender wooden staff with a clear glass bottle set in its head, a little pale mist inside. A bright, chattering, colour-loving air; she cannot bear dark colours on herself.
face: FACE, as in the references: a fresh, pretty young elf woman's face of about twenty-four: wide bright pale-violet eyes under open, relaxed brows, a small nose, lips closed; long pointed ears with a small white mole on the tip of the left ear (on the viewer's right); long, very pale grass-green hair.
build: 175 cm, slender and long-limbed: light shoulders, a B-cup, a firm narrow waist and full hips, long legs.
palette: pale grass green and soft violet, clear glass, leaf-vein silver, pale linen white
casual: Her own forest dress: an ankle-length dress of pale leaf-green linen with fitted long sleeves and buttons down the front, a narrow belt of plaited grass fibre, soft boots; the shawl sewn with clear glass beads over her shoulders; the slender wooden staff with its glass bottle in one hand. A bright, curious look.
private: Mixing mist at her window: a loose long-sleeved pale linen house dress, the hair loose, a small apron with green stains. She holds a small glass vial of dark mist up to the light and frowns at its colour, a pouting, absorbed look.
battle: Lifting the deep mist into the sky, in the finest warden's gear of the forest, all in pale colours by her own choice: a long fitted robe of pale leaf green layered over light scale armour of living bark, each scale edged in fine silver leaf-veins that glow soft green; living-wood bracers sprouting tiny leaves; the glass-beaded shawl worn as a mantle, every bead shining green. She holds the slender staff high in both hands, the glass bottle at its head glowing with pale mist, and coils of green mist rise and wind close around her body; singing, a clear, intent look.
formal: Before the court of the crowned forest: a long gown of the palest green silk to the floor with fitted long sleeves, a mantle of fine white gauze sewn with clear glass beads, a slim circlet of twisted silver twigs. She holds the staff with its glass bottle upright, a pleased, graceful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale violet eyes looking up past the viewer at a bottle of glowing mist, a hopeful, absorbed look, the lips closed. Soft green-tinted light falling through leaves from above. Foreground blur: a clear glass bottle of pale mist and a drifting leaf. She wears the glass-beaded shawl over the pale green dress.

name: 黛特琳德·凯勒
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2294
gear: 传奇（撼世，832年凝名时英雄过半，约860年LVL 208）｜中（苇岸做纸人家）｜朴素（不穿甲，不戴首饰）｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身，可她是做纸、教书的，招牌是烧起来的纸和灯匣，不穿甲；最好的料子用在防火的墨蓝长外套和皮围裙上，样子照旧朴素；832年在1020年以前。
who: Detlinde Keller, a woman of the reed-bank paper-making families, called One Hillside of Paper Fire, a legend who has looked thirty-one since her name was made, with a trace of tiredness from late nights about the eyes: about 166 cm, a long neck, slender fingers whose knuckles often crack. Ink-blue hair pinned in a low bun, pale amber eyes that shine like honey near lamplight, a small mole under the right eye (her right, on the viewer's left when she faces us). An ink-dark apron whose edge is burned with a row of tiny pinholes. No jewellery. A gentle, focused air of a careful teacher.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gentle, clear woman's face of about thirty-one: calm, attentive pale amber eyes with a faint tiredness beneath them, soft brows, a small nose, a closed mouth; a small mole under the right eye (on the viewer's left); ink-blue hair in a low bun; no jewellery.
build: 166 cm, slender: a long neck, narrow shoulders, a C-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips, thin hands.
palette: ink blue and pale amber, paper white, reed buff, ember orange
casual: Her work clothes on the library hill: a long-sleeved dress of grey-blue wool buttoned up the front, the collar smoothed flat, a long ink-dark apron with a row of tiny burn holes along its edge, black cloth sleeve guards, soft shoes; a wooden box for lamp ribs and old paper slung at her hip on a strap. She holds a folded paper lantern, a calm, attentive look.
private: Late at night by her own lamp: a loose long-sleeved dress of soft undyed linen, a knitted shawl, the bun loosened. She holds a small, worn hand-copied book open in both hands, a quiet, tender look.
battle: Setting the hillside of paper alight, in fireproof legend's work gear, plain by choice: a long coat of dark ink-blue wool woven with fine fire-ward thread, closed down the front with plain buttons, its seams stitched with faint glowing gold script; a fire-proofed leather apron keeping the old row of burn holes; supple leather bracers and gloves cut away at the fingertips; the wooden lamp box open at her hip. Dozens of burning sheets of paper fly up around her like fans of bright gold and white flame, circling close; she lifts one lit page between two fingers. A calm, sorrowful, steady look.
formal: At the papermakers' first burning of autumn: a long dark blue wool dress with a smooth high collar, a clean pale linen apron over it, no jewellery, the bun neat. She holds a single unlit paper lantern in both hands, a grave, gentle look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale amber eyes glowing like honey in the light of a paper lantern held close to her face, a quiet, tender look, the lips closed. Warm gold lantern light from below on one side, deep blue night on the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers and the curling edge of a burning page. She wears the grey-blue dress and the ink-dark apron.

name: 琴希尔德·罗特曼
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2372
gear: 传奇（撼世，879年凝名时英雄后半，约895年LVL 206）｜贫（墙东生角人家）｜照常｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身，英雄往上不看家境；她在联军这一边，879年在1020年以前，不写成批的附魔铠甲，用红土烧成的陶片甲，土纹发红光，招牌是陶片手甲。
who: Kinhild Rothmann, a horned demon woman of the free-horn families east of the wall, fighting on the allied side, called the Red-Earth Rampart, a legend who has looked twenty-five or twenty-six since her name was made: about 180 cm, broad-shouldered and long-legged. A pair of short horns curving backward, with no fire on them at all. Short bright red hair tied back so the horns show plainly, orange-gold eyes, thick brows, a faint scar across the bridge of the nose from a childhood fall. Warm light skin. Red clay always under her fingernails. Thick gauntlets set with ceramic plates. A frank, warm, open-hearted air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a bright, open, handsome woman's face of about twenty-five: orange-gold eyes under thick red brows, a faint pale scar across the bridge of the nose, a straight nose, a wide closed mouth; short bright red hair drawn back; a pair of short backward-curving horns with no flame on them; warm light skin.
build: 180 cm, tall and athletic: broad shoulders, strong arms, a D-cup, a firm waist and broad hips, long legs.
palette: brick red and orange gold, fired clay red, wheat gold, earth brown
casual: Her field clothes on the wheat farms: a short sleeveless leather jerkin laced over a long-sleeved shirt of undyed wool with the sleeves rolled, a wide leather belt, sturdy trousers and boots caked with red clay; the thick ceramic-plated gauntlets hang at her belt, a strip of an old faded headscarf sewn around each cuff. She stands with one hand at the base of a horn, a cheerful, slightly shy look.
private: At her mother's door: a loose long-sleeved dress of soft rust-red wool, a clean apron, the red hair loose to the jaw. She holds a neatly folded old headscarf in both hands, a soft, happy look.
battle: Raising the rampart, in a legend's harness of fired earth: a fitted cuirass and tassets of glazed red ceramic plates, kiln-hard and laced over thick leather, each plate etched with layered earth-script that glows warm red; broad ceramic pauldrons; a short cloak of wheat-gold wool; the thick gauntlets on both hands, their ceramic palms glowing red, a strip of old headscarf at each cuff. She thrusts both palms forward, ribbons of glowing red earth rising and coiling around her forearms; the horns bare and fireless, a steady, determined look.
formal: Thanked by the villages east of the wall at harvest: a long-sleeved dress of deep red wool to the ankle with a laced bodice, a wheat-gold sash, a crown of plaited wheat stalks set between the horns, the hair brushed back. She holds the ceramic gauntlets folded together in her hands, an embarrassed, pleased look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly aside, the orange-gold eyes smiling at the viewer, a warm, shy look, the lips closed. Golden harvest sunlight from one side. Foreground blur: ears of wheat and a fleck of red earth. She wears the leather jerkin, the horns bare.

name: 菈缇丝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2411
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 214）｜中（梦魔人家）｜不靠装备（靠歌，不拿兵器）｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身；她靠歌，不近身，穿梦魔一路的长裙甲，里头衬黑曜细鳞，肩上几片磨亮的黑曜镜片（照炮的年月梦魔缀镜片往前推一点），颈侧的纹要露出来。
who: Latis, a dream-demon woman of the camps across the south wall, called the Whole Wall Asleep, a legend who has looked about twenty since her name was made: about 168 cm, soft-waisted and level-shouldered. Long dark violet hair in a single braid over her right shoulder (her right, on the viewer's left when she faces us). Pale rose-pink eyes. A pair of thin horns lying close along the hairline. Soft full lips. On both sides of the neck, two patches of dark velvety markings that glow faintly when she sings. Loose ends of mismatched mending thread cling to her clothes. A small silver bell wrapped in cloth. A soft, approachable air that turns quietly unsettling when she holds someone's gaze.
face: FACE, as in the references: a soft, lovely woman's face of about twenty: gently curved pale rose-pink eyes, fine dark violet brows, a small nose, soft full lips closed; thin horns lying close along the hairline; dark velvety markings on both sides of the neck.
build: 168 cm, soft and graceful: level shoulders, a D-cup, a soft narrow waist and rounded hips.
palette: dark violet and rose pink, night black, dull silver, mismatched mending threads
casual: Her camp clothes behind the tents: a long dress of dark violet wool with fitted long sleeves and a modest neckline, a darker shawl around the shoulders with stray coloured threads caught in it, a narrow belt with a small sewing pouch, soft boots; the silver bell wrapped in a scrap of cloth hangs at her belt. She holds a half-darned child's sock and a needle, a gentle, absent look.
private: Singing a child to sleep: a loose long-sleeved house dress of soft grey-violet wool, the braid undone, bare feet. She cradles a folded child's blanket in her arms, a soft, faraway look, the lips closed.
battle: Singing the wall to sleep, in the finest dream-demon gear, made for a singer and not a fighter: a long layered gown-armour of night-violet cloth over fine black obsidian scale, cut low at the collar to leave the neck markings bare, the scales glinting with dull silver dream-script; small polished obsidian plates at the shoulders like dark mirrors; a sweeping night-black mantle lined in rose. She holds the cloth-wrapped silver bell loosely in one hand, the other hand raised as if leading a song, the neck markings glowing, pale violet ripples of song curling close around her; a calm, sweet, faraway look.
formal: Before the high seat of the dream-demons: a long gown of deep violet velvet to the floor with fitted sleeves, a sheer black over-mantle sewn with tiny silver beads, a thin silver chain along the hairline between the horns, the braid laid over her right shoulder. She stands with her hands folded over the wrapped bell, a gracious, unreadable look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted a little, the pale rose-pink eyes curved warmly toward the viewer but holding the gaze a moment too long, a sweet, unsettling look, the lips closed. Dim violet dusk light from one side, a faint glow from the neck markings. Foreground blur: a dangling strand of coloured mending thread and the cloth-wrapped silver bell. She wears the dark violet dress and shawl.

name: 温菲丽德·舒勒
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2450
gear: 传奇（撼世，1003年凝名时英雄，约1025年LVL 210）｜中（银帆港船家）｜照常｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身；画的是1003年河口那三夜往后，在1020年以前，不写成批的附魔铠甲，用量身打的港钢胸甲和绳结符文，招牌是父亲那只大锚和锚链上的白线。
who: Winfride Schuler, a woman of the silver-sail harbour boat families at the golden-kite river mouth, called the Anchor of the Tide, a legend who has looked thirty-five since her name was made: tall, about 182 cm, broad-backed and solid-legged, her arms corded from years of hauling rope. Short sand-gold hair, sea-blue eyes, the tip of the nose reddened by sea wind. A diagonal scar across the left cheek from a snapping rope (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us), never hidden. Big, rough palms. A large iron anchor with long flukes, its stock wrapped in old sailcloth and crusted with a white salt pattern. A broad, open, laughing air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, frank woman's face of about thirty-five: wide sea-blue eyes, straight sandy brows, a nose reddened at the tip by the wind, a wide closed mouth; a thin diagonal scar across the left cheek (on the viewer's right); short sand-gold hair.
build: 182 cm, tall and powerful: a broad back and shoulders, rope-muscled arms, a D-cup, a firm waist and broad hips, strong legs.
palette: sand gold and sea blue, salt white, tarred rope brown, sailcloth grey
casual: Her harbour clothes: a short oilcloth jacket in faded blue over a long-sleeved striped wool shirt, a wide leather belt with a marlinspike, canvas trousers rolled to the shin and sea boots; a coil of rope over one shoulder; the chain of the big iron anchor slung over the other shoulder, the anchor hanging at her back. A warm, broad-smiling look.
private: In her draughty little house: a loose long-sleeved knitted fisherman's sweater in grey, wool trousers, thick socks. She holds a folded square of old patched sail in both hands, a quiet, fond look.
battle: Holding the river mouth against the tide, in the finest sea-harness of the harbour: a fitted breastplate of salt-white harbour steel over tarred leather, its edges etched with knotted rope-runes that glow pale white like salt crystals; heavy articulated pauldrons, the right one wrapped in chain; rope-bound steel vambraces and sea boots plated at the shin; a short cloak of old sailcloth. She hauls the anchor chain taut across her body with both hands, the great long-fluked anchor swinging close at her side, a line of white light running along the chain; feet braced, a fierce, laughing, straining look.
formal: When the boat families thank her at the stone pillar: a deep blue wool harbour coat with every brass button in place, a white shirt, clean boots, a short sailcloth cape. She holds a loop of rope wound once around her hand, an awkward, grinning look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the sea-blue eyes laughing at the viewer, the lips closed, the scar plain on her cheek. Bright cold sea light from one side, spray grey on the other. Foreground blur: a heavy iron chain link and flying spray. She wears the faded blue oilcloth jacket.

name: 芬妮娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2489
gear: 传奇（撼世，1024年凝名时英雄后半，约1045年LVL 204）｜贫（找地方住的魔族人家）｜不靠装备（想种花、领路，不打仗）｜5档｜传奇取顶上那一身，可她不穿甲、不拿兵器，最好的东西用在会长新叶的绿斗篷上，招牌是那根没开过花的硬枝和一袋干净的土。
who: Fenia, a demon woman of a slow-growing lineage who led her people out of a cursed slope, called Grass Turned Back, a legend who has looked twenty-three or twenty-four since her name was made: about 170 cm, slim-waisted with strong legs, white skin. Long milk-white hair in a loose braid. Deep gold eyes. The long-lived line has NO horns, NO scales and NO tail: a smooth brow, faintly pointed ear tips half hidden in the hair. Mud always on her ankles; the second toe of her left foot curls in a little. A pouch of clean earth carried close. A hard branch that has never flowered, an old cloth wrapped round its tip, serves as her walking staff. A gentle, curious, earnest air, not childish.
face: FACE, as in the references: a soft, clear young woman's face of about twenty-three, NOT childish: deep gold eyes with a curious look, light milk-white brows, a small nose, lips closed; long milk-white hair; white skin.
build: 170 cm, slender and strong-legged: a slim back, an E-cup, a very narrow waist and gently rounded hips, sturdy legs.
palette: milk white and deep gold, new-grass green, earth brown, faded flower-print cloth
casual: Her travelling clothes: a long-sleeved dress of undyed linen to the calf, tucked up at one side for walking, a green wool overdress laced at the front, a broad cloth sash with the small pouch of clean earth tied at it, mud-spattered ankle boots; the hard branch staff with its cloth-wrapped tip in her hand. A curious, gentle look.
private: Tending a flower: a loose long-sleeved dress of faded rose cotton, the braid loose, bare feet with mud on the ankles. She holds a small clay pot with a single plain yellow flower, a tender, wistful look.
battle: Walking the road backward through the cursed grass, unarmoured by her own choice, in the finest traveller's gear a legend could carry: a long hooded mantle of deep green wool woven with fine living threads that sprout tiny new leaves and glow soft green along the hem, over the long linen dress tucked up for walking; supple leather bracers stitched with root patterns; wrapped walking boots. She grips the hard branch staff in both hands, planting it behind her as she steps back, threads of bright green grass-light curling up around her legs and the staff; an intent, careful look.
formal: Among the people she led out: a long dress of pale linen with a laced green bodice, a garland of small plain wild flowers in the milk-white hair, the pouch of clean earth at the sash. She holds a little earth cupped in both palms, offering it, a shy, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, a handful of clean earth held up near her chin, the deep gold eyes looking at the viewer over it, a hopeful, curious look, the lips closed. Soft spring morning light from one side. Foreground blur: upright blades of grass and a small new sprout. She wears the green wool overdress.

name: 妲格玛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1871
gear: 传奇（撼世，页上只给撼世）｜中（★起的）｜照常（甲做轻，好不停地挪）｜5档｜样子、族、兵器页上都不给，照名号无定处和她从不在一处停一口气起：轻甲、一支长枪、身后留残影；340年代在1020年以前，用量身打的老墙钢，刃和甲上刻神名、亮一点光，照灯的年月的口径。
who: Dagmar, a legendary warden of the south wall, called Never in One Place, a woman who has looked about thirty since her name was made: about 172 cm, lean and light-footed. Ash-rose hair in a long single braid down her back, warm topaz eyes, a thin silver cuff on the rim of her left ear (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us). Fair skin. A long, light spear with a narrow leaf-shaped blade. A restless, alert air; she never stands in one spot for long and always seems half a step from moving.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, alert woman's face of about thirty: warm topaz eyes, quick and searching, slim straight brows, a fine straight nose, a closed mouth; ash-rose hair in a long braid; a thin silver cuff on the rim of the left ear (on the viewer's right); fair skin.
build: 172 cm, lean and light: narrow shoulders, a C-cup, a slim waist and rounded hips, long, quick legs.
palette: frost blue and topaz, wall grey, faded garrison red, bright steel
casual: Her garrison clothes on the south wall: a long undyed grey wool wall coat open over a close leather jerkin, a dark red wool scarf, a thin cord tied at her right wrist, fitted trousers and soft boots; the long light spear held loosely at her side. She stands with her weight on one foot as if about to move, a quick, watchful look.
private: Off the wall for an hour: a loose long-sleeved wool tunic in faded red, dark trousers, the braid half unbound. She holds a hot cup in both hands and glances aside, a restless, wry look.
battle: Never in one place on the parapet, in a south-wall legend's harness made light for speed: a fitted half-cuirass of old wall-steel engraved with a running line of white god-name script that glows faintly, laced over dark leather; a single articulated pauldron on the left shoulder; long steel vambraces and greaves; a short grey cloak. She holds the long light spear low and back, its narrow leaf blade lit with a thin pale light, and two fading afterimages of her trail behind her as she steps; a sharp, wary look.
formal: At the wall's gathering of wardens: the grey wall coat brushed clean with a small nailed iron badge at the chest, the red scarf, the cord at the wrist, the braid neat. She holds the spear upright beside her, a composed, wary look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, glancing back over her shoulder at the viewer, the topaz eyes sharp and searching, the lips closed. Pale grey dawn light along the wall from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a stone merlon and a single falling dark feather. She wears the grey wall coat and red scarf.

name: 法埃尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1872
gear: 传奇（撼世，页上只给撼世）｜中（★起的）｜照常（为了不出声不穿板甲）｜5档｜样子、族、兵器页上都不给，照名号隙间的弦和他只在夜里巡起：拿发光的细弦当兵器，甲用不响的细链甲和皮，链环里穿着符文；340到369年在1020年以前，照灯的年月。
who: Fael, a legendary warden of the south wall, called the String in the Gaps, a man who has looked about thirty-five since his name was made: about 179 cm, lean and long-armed. Dark slate hair with a green sheen, shoulder-length and tied low at the nape. Pale silver-blue eyes that see well in the dark. A fine white line across the bridge of the nose, an old cut from a wire. Fair skin. On both hands, fingerless dark gloves fitted with small steel reels at the wrists that pay out fine silver threads. He never stands on the open parapet and walks the wall only at night. A quiet, wary, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, quiet man's face of about thirty-five: narrow, watchful pale silver-blue eyes, straight dark brows, a fine white scar across the bridge of the nose, a closed mouth; dark slate hair with a green sheen tied low; fair skin.
build: 179 cm, lean and long-armed: wiry shoulders, narrow hips and long hands.
palette: dark slate green and silver blue, night grey, thread silver, worn black leather
casual: His night-patrol clothes: a long dark grey hooded wall coat over a close black leather jerkin, a thin cord tied at the left wrist, dark trousers and soft-soled boots; fingerless dark gloves with small steel thread-reels at both wrists; a shuttered hand lantern, unlit, hangs at his belt. He stands turned a little sideways, a quiet, listening look.
private: Winding thread at dawn before he sleeps: a loose long-sleeved dark linen shirt, soft trousers, the hair untied. He winds silver thread onto a small steel reel, a calm, tired look.
battle: Stringing the gaps of the wall at night, in a south-wall legend's harness made for silence: a close-fitting coat of dark leather over a fine black mail shirt whose rings are threaded with silver script glowing faint blue, no plate that could ring; dark steel vambraces fitted with thread-reels; the hood pulled up, a long dark cloak. His hands are spread with the fingers crooked, and a web of fine glowing silver threads runs taut between them and arcs out close around him like the strings of a great harp; a still, listening look.
formal: At the wall's gathering of wardens: the long dark grey wall coat brushed clean, a small iron badge at the chest, the cord at the wrist, the dark gloves on, the hair tied neatly. He stands sideways with his hands clasped behind him, a reserved look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the hood half back, the pale silver-blue eyes looking past the viewer into the dark, a still, listening look, the lips closed. Faint starlight from above, a glint of silver thread catching it. Foreground blur: a taut glowing thread across the frame and the edge of dark stone. He wears the dark grey hooded wall coat.
